market_view: The market is in a sharp risk-off regime with QQQ down 2.2% and VIXY up 3.8%, favoring short setups on weak names or high-conviction breakouts. Spotify and Comcast gapped up on earnings but show mixed signals; I will focus on shorting weakness or riding strong momentum in resilient names.

decisions.reason: Comcast beat Q3 but announced significant job cuts and a large Q4 restructuring charge, citing demand pressure in parks. In a risk-off market, this negative guidance is a clear short catalyst despite the initial gap up.
Disney is breaking out above its opening range (111.79-112.53) with positive momentum and a new trailer release for 'Hexed'. It is trading above VWAP, showing relative strength in a falling market.
